UGC NET 2026 Results and Answer Keys Released

The University Grants Commission National Eligibility Test (UGC-NET) 2026 results have been released, with over 97,000 candidates qualifying for PhD admissions. The final answer keys for 84 subjects have also been published. Candidates can check their scorecards, cut-off marks, and merit lists on the official UGC-NET website.
